your_book:
Tuesday was a rough session for Jaleel's book, which slipped roughly 0.2% on the day as broad macro pressure — Brent crude near $98 reigniting inflation fears and renewed Middle East tensions — hammered growth and healthcare names alike. The damage was widespread: all but four positions closed in the red. The deepest single-name wound came from Novartis (NVS), which cratered nearly 14% on the day and is now down over 15% in the book — a punishing move in a small position, but the headline catalyst appears tied to Amgen's freefall rather than NVS-specific news, which demands verification. Boston Scientific (BSX) shed another 5.9% and is now 8.2% underwater, compounding a guidance-slash story that has yet to find a floor ahead of the October 28 report. The book's two bright spots were Rocket Lab (RKLB) (+2.5%) and Lululemon (LULU) (+2.6%), though both remain deeply in the red on a cost basis — down 15.9% and 19.3% respectively — so today's bounces are noise against a troubled trend.

The clearest thesis drift sits in BSX: rated Strong Buy with a QARP of 79.6, yet the fundamental story (flat guidance through Q3, Watchman softness) keeps price moving the wrong direction. ADBE also deserves scrutiny — down 3.5% today on macro rotation, and facing a genuine narrative problem around AI disruption and CFO turnover with earnings due in two days on September 10. The numbers have been fine; the sentiment has not, and that gap is widening. RKLB remains the outlier with an AVOID verdict — any bounce there isn't a reason to add, it's an opportunity to reconsider the position.

Watch the September 10 ADBE print closely — it's the first near-term catalyst that could either restore or further damage that narrative. The pharma cluster (NVS, GILD, NBIX, VRTX) carries a drug-pricing overhang that today's NVS move makes more urgent to monitor. Energy via EXE (+0.3%) held up quietly and remains one of the few names in positive territory on a cost basis with a constructive verdict — a pocket of relative stability worth noting.

attention.headline: NVS drops ~14% — source of move must be confirmed immediately
attention.note: The only headline surfaced links the move to Amgen's collapse rather than a Novartis-specific event; if it's sympathy selling the position may be oversold, but if there is an undisclosed NVS catalyst, the book's entire pharma cluster carries contagion risk.

attention.headline: Earnings September 10 — narrative risk is the real exam, not the numbers
attention.note: ADBE has beaten and raised yet sold off before; with AI-moat fears, a departed CFO, and ARR de-emphasis already in the air, Wednesday's print is a binary sentiment event that could validate or break the current BUY thesis.

attention.headline: Down 5.9% today, -8.2% in the book — guidance-cut story finding no floor
attention.note: A Strong Buy / QARP 79.6 rating is in direct tension with a management team that guided flat through Q3; price and thesis are diverging meaningfully and the next update isn't until October 28.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated position bounced today — thesis conflict unresolved
attention.note: A 2.5% up-day on an AVOID-verdict holding with a QARP of 38.7 and a cost-basis loss of 15.9% is not a recovery signal; the position's continued presence warrants a deliberate hold-or-exit decision rather than passive drift.
